name: paper-pop
summary: Japanese paper-craft ad look (切り絵 + テロップ): warm paper ground with fibre texture and graph-paper/gingham boards, layered paper-cut character faces (shared/characters/paper) that boil at 8fps, white-rim cutout stickers with stacked soft shadows, double-outlined telop on cushions (座布団), shout brackets ＼ ／, red-pen marks / red sheet / masking tape, manga concentration lines. Cover colours (yellow/navy) + red pen; gold on the logo only. Concentric-ring / paper-tear transitions.
font_line: Paperlogy only — 600 outlined telop / bubbles / labels, 700 plain text, 800 numerals + onomatopoeia (shared/fonts Paperlogy 5/6/7/8)
accent_alternatives: take yellow/navy from any cover with cover_palette.py
